description: Two men in a rustic wooden mill with a large water wheel visible through a doorway. The man on the left, in an apron and rolled shirt, pours a burlap sack of dark cocoa beans into a funnel above a big stone grinding wheel. The man on the right, in a dark coat with white hair and spectacles, holds a wooden tray with a dark chocolate cake. Gears, a wooden vat and sacks of beans fill the background. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
